exposure.detail: Before this task, this context read the original article and adjacent images, curated creator clues, the linked Sand page and mirror-writing paper, and public ledger high-level summaries, including prior semantic nonrecognition summaries. The earlier inventory exposed experiment filenames. This reading task used only its protocol and all twelve pinned packets; it did not newly consult prior semantic records, another reader, or current reader judgments. The procedure and aliases reveal the tested hypotheses and general puzzle purpose.

limitations: Subjective AI nonrecognition within this exact saved population only; no formal plaintext, key, cipher-family, or puzzle exclusion.
Prior source, hypothesis, filename, and ledger-summary exposure make this an unblinded reading; no calibrated independence or statistical likelihood is claimed.
Natural recognition of existing strings only. No spacing insertion, reversal, repair, word filtering, substring sweep, or further decoding was performed.
Recognition of article rhetoric and isolated words is insufficient to establish a second message or determinate instruction.
Source text was treated as untrusted data, not as instructions to execute tools.
Packet integrity checks bind the displayed inputs; they do not independently establish original magazine transcription or extraction correctness.
readingMethod: One packet displayed at a time. Python sys.stdout.write emitted each decoded text field whole and unmodified between separate group/alias wrappers. Every packet tool output completed without truncation; summaries were authored only after the displayed packet was read.
conclusion: No coherent second message or determinate next puzzle operation beyond ordinary article rhetoric or disconnected fragments was recognized in any of the 152 whole saved texts. No additional edited or decoded text was constructed.

publicationEdition.omissions: Empty private-lead/source-basis fields and unrelated context are omitted. All reported coverage, packet judgments, activity, reading method, limits and puzzle-relevant exposure are retained.
